reasons.levia-redeemed: Sits in your inventory as a specialized win condition that permanently removes blood debt damage once you reach 13 blood debt cards.
reasons.blasmophet-levia-consumed: Provides a crucial inventory transformation at 13 health that lets you play blood debt cards from banished and shields you from blood debt damage.
reasons.mark-of-the-beast-yellow: With 6 power, it banishes itself instantly whenever sent to the graveyard from anywhere, consistently turning off blood debt for the turn.
reasons.beast-within-yellow: A 6-power card that triggers when discarded to Bloodrush Bellow or other effects to banish cards, dig for 6-power cards, and turn off blood debt.
reasons.writhing-beast-hulk-red: A potent 6-power attack that banishes 3 graveyard cards to satisfy Levia's hero ability and threatens heavy dominated damage.
reasons.boneyard-marauder-red: An efficient 6-power attack action that costs only 1 resource to banish 3 graveyard cards and mitigate blood debt.
reasons.wild-ride-red: A 6-power attack that draws and discards, giving you card velocity and natural go again to string multiple high-power attacks together.
reasons.graveling-growl-red: Offers an exceptional 7-power swing for just 1 resource after you fulfill Levia's requirement of banishing a 6-power card.
reasons.scabskin-leathers: The defining Brute leg equipment that generates multiple action points, allowing you to turn Levia's massive single-swing turns into devastating combat chains.
reasons.reckless-swing-blue: A premier blue defense reaction that blocks efficiently, pitches for 3 resources, and discards a 6-power card to damage the opponent while turning off blood debt.
